findings.evidence: Node v24.16.0: `vm.runInNewContext('1', vm.constants.DONT_CONTEXTIFY, { contextName: 1 })` -> `TypeError ERR_INVALID_ARG_TYPE The "options.contextName" property must be of type string. Received type number (1)`. rifty (scratch vitest probe on HEAD, vm/index.ts): same call -> `NotImplementedError Not implemented: vm.createContext.DONT_CONTEXTIFY …`. Also `vm.createContext(Symbol('x'))`: Node ERR_INVALID_ARG_TYPE 'The "object" argument must be of type object. Received type symbol'; rifty `TypeError: Object.defineProperty called on non-object` (pre-existing for primitives; the diff widens the parameter type to `T | symbol`, and dont-contextify-ceiling.test.ts:45 asserts only 'not NotImplementedError').
findings.summary: ADR-0464 §2 (line 38) and modules.md:172 say the DONT_CONTEXTIFY ceiling comes 'after Node's option validation' for runInNewContext as well. rifty's runInNewContext never validates Node's context options (contextName/contextOrigin/contextCodeGeneration/microtaskMode; a pre-existing gap), so on invalid context options it throws the ceiling where Node throws ERR_INVALID_ARG_TYPE. Both are loud on an unclaimed mode. Narrow the wording to createContext, or validate those options first.

findings.evidence: Node v24.16.0: `function Old(o){ http.Agent.call(this,o) } util.inherits(Old, http.Agent); new Old({keepAlive:true})` -> ok (Old); `http.Agent({keepAlive:true})` -> ok (Agent); `Object.getPrototypeOf(https.Agent) === http.Agent` -> true. rifty (scratch vitest probe on HEAD, http/index.ts): both constructions -> `TypeError: Class constructor Agent cannot be invoked without 'new'`; prototype check -> false.
findings.summary: http.Agent is an ES class. The util.inherits pattern (`http.Agent.call(this, opts)`, used by forever-agent/tunnel-agent-style subclasses) and call-without-new fail with a bare TypeError, not the named NotImplementedError('node:http.Agent'). https.Agent is also not linked to http.Agent (Node: its prototype, recorded in the unit's own evidence:349). A throwing `function Agent()` would name every path. This is advisory: the class-extends path vitest browser mode takes is named.
